skill.summary: Tier and prioritize a prospect list using the six-level Prospecting Pyramid framework — sorting every account from unknown contacts at the base to active buy...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — tiers and prioritizes prospect lists using the Prospecting Pyramid framework.

- Classifies each prospect into one of six tiers based on qualification and buying-window proximity.
- Generates a daily action plan specifying which tier to call first and recommended actions for each.
- Works with CSV, markdown tables, or pasted text; requires only minimal qualification data per prospect.
- Flags missing data and suggests how to remedy gaps that prevent accurate tiering.
- Provides clear call order and action directives to maximize productivity during prospecting blocks.
